newsitem.title: THAILAND: Texaco sells Yetagun natgas to Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Texaco sells Yetagun natgas to Thailand.

text.p: A unit of Texaco Inc signed a deal on Thursday to sell 200 million cubic feet per day (mmmcfd) of natural gas from Burma's Yetagun field to Thailand over 30 years, state-run Petroluem Authority of Thailand (PTT) said.
Production will come onstream in late 1999, said PTT which is the buyer of the natural gas.
Like natural gas purchased from the nearby Yadana field, gas from Yetagun will be used mainly as a fuel for a 2,800 megawatt power station in Thailand's western province of Ratchaburi.
The Yetagun field is located in Burma's Gulf of Martaban and has estimated natural gas reserve of 1.1 trillion cubic feet per day.

Texaco holds 35.42 percent interest in the field, PTT Exploration and Production Plc, a unit of PTT, 14.17 percent, Nippon Oil unit Nippon Oil Exploration (Myanmar) 14.17 percent, the Myanmar Oil and Gas Enterprise 15 percent and Premier Oil unit Premier Petroleum Myanmar Ltd 21.25 percent. The numbers are rounded up.
